# PerchTV 0.1.21

The Samsung set shows the PerchTV artwork on its home screen.

## WHAT CHANGED

- On the Samsung set: the PerchTV tile in Smart Hub now carries the PerchTV artwork — the bird on its perch — instead of the stock placeholder the set drew before.
- On the Onn: no change of its own. Both televisions move to 0.1.21 together.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Pairing, casting, play/pause and stop, the skip keys, hold ▲ for 8x on the Samsung set, the Loading screen, the waiting screen that moves and goes dark, the connection check every 45 seconds, a dropped stream coming back on its own, the question card from the phone, and the update check on every start.
